d535a0dbfe40.curator_note: A dedicated day-to-dusk Amelie Lens set at Grand Park, not a shared festival stage — genuinely the better way to catch her than the HARD Summer slot the same month. Extended techno-into-acid-into-trance from a real headliner in a proper Factory 93 room.
d535a0dbfe40.description: Factory 93 presents a solo, day-to-dusk Amelie Lens set (techno, acid, trance) at Grand Park Block 2, DTLA.

edab80bd44cb.curator_note: Overmono is a tracked name and this is a proper club date, not a festival slot — the Gawsworth brothers' rave-nostalgic breaks-and-melody sound (Fabric, Warp) translates well to the Palladium's room, with a dedicated Vinyl Room opening early at 6:30.
edab80bd44cb.description: UK duo Overmono's 'Pure Devotion' world tour stops at Hollywood Palladium, doors 8pm with a 6:30pm Vinyl Room opener.

artist_notes.name: Rich Medina
artist_notes.note: Philly institution, 25+ years in — founder of Jump n Funk (North America's original Afrobeat party) and one of the great genre-agnostic all-night selectors, moving through house, soul, afrobeat, funk, breaks and rare groove.

2c126d230d6c.curator_note: An open-to-close Rich Medina set billed explicitly as house/rare-groove/garage is exactly the deep-crate education worth clearing a whole Saturday night for at a tiki bar like High Tide.
2c126d230d6c.description: All-night open-to-close set (10pm) from Philly selector Rich Medina — house, rare groove and garage classics — at High Tide's Little Tokyo/Arts District bar.

artist_notes.name: Dublon
artist_notes.note: Oslo producer/DJ who went viral on TikTok with jazz-inflected house ('Summer in Marseile,' 'belle') — his 'Nectar' EP features jazz saxophonist Nathan Haines; real touring history across European clubs (London's Jazz Café) despite the social-media breakout.

bf5bb21c979b.curator_note: TikTok-viral is a red flag on paper, but the jazz-house sound is legit and a 5pm rooftop slot at Harbor House is the right room for it — closer to a sunset groove set than a hype booking.
bf5bb21c979b.description: 5pm sunset rooftop party at Harbor House DTLA headlined by Oslo jazz-house producer Dublon.

artist_notes.name: Gabriella Rose
artist_notes.note: Coeur d'Alene singer-songwriter blending vintage country, indie folk and pop — broke through as the featured vocalist on Zach Bryan's 'Madeline.' Opening this leg of Kacey's tour.

6d1613301e21.curator_note: Not remotely the club lane, but Kacey's a real Spotify staple for you and this is the 'Middle of Nowhere' arena tour hitting DTLA — go for the songs, not the scene.
6d1613301e21.description: Kacey Musgraves' 'Middle of Nowhere' arena tour at Crypto.com Arena, with singer-songwriter Gabriella Rose opening.

artist_notes.name: Estevie
artist_notes.note: LA-based mainstream-pop artist — catchy, hooky songwriting, not a name outside pop-radio circles. Opening this second DTLA date on Kacey's tour.

c5a4ec16269a.curator_note: Same arena run as the night before, just a different opener (LA pop act Estevie instead of Gabriella Rose) — pick whichever date works, the calculus doesn't change.
c5a4ec16269a.description: Kacey Musgraves' 'Middle of Nowhere' arena tour, second Crypto.com Arena date, with pop artist Estevie opening.

artist_notes.name: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong
artist_notes.note: Baltimore funk/jam band — extended improvisational jams over a funk-rock base, built around a dedicated touring jam-scene fanbase rather than club culture.

999952fc903e.curator_note: This is a proper jam band, not remotely house or techno, but Teragram is one of the better small rooms in the city for a live set and a funk-forward jam show there on a Friday is a fine change of pace if you're not chasing a DJ that night.
999952fc903e.description: Baltimore funk/jam band Pigeons Playing Ping Pong's Fall Tour stop at Teragram Ballroom.

artist_notes.name: Brigid Dawson
artist_notes.note: Longtime Thee Oh Sees/Osees co-vocalist and keyboardist who left the band years ago and has just rejoined for this LA residency run, revisiting songs from the Carrion Crawler/Help era; also has a solo career (2020's Ballet of Apes).

artist_notes.name: George Chen
artist_notes.note: Likely the Bay Area experimental/noise musician and longtime scene organizer (Zum zine/label, bands like Chen Santa Maria) — a fittingly oddball opener rather than a straight rock act.

a3388ccb7f28.curator_note: Brigid Dawson stepping back into the band for this residency run is real news for anyone who followed Thee Oh Sees through the Carrion Crawler era — Dwyer's outfit live is still one of the most unhinged, physical shows in town.
a3388ccb7f28.description: Osees play a run of older material at the Bellwether with longtime member Brigid Dawson back in the band, plus support from George Chen.

770573bb005f.curator_note: Skip out on the mellow surf-folk headliner if you must, but get there for Hermanos Gutiérrez — their wordless, cinematic guitar duets are exactly the desert-blues wavelength she runs on.
770573bb005f.description: Jack Johnson's 'SURFILMUSIC' tour stops at the Hollywood Bowl, with Swiss-Ecuadorian instrumental duo Hermanos Gutiérrez opening.

f177a55bf75a.curator_note: One of her tracked names playing a real room — the bass playing alone justifies the Palladium ticket, Brainfeeder jazz-funk at its most virtuosic.
f177a55bf75a.description: Thundercat's 'Distracted AF' tour hits the Hollywood Palladium, with support from fera.

artist_notes.name: Jimi Jules
artist_notes.note: Zurich-born, Berlin-based (longtime Watergate resident) house producer now signed to Innervisions — jazzy, soulful, musician's-ear house that broke through via 2014's Defected hit 'Pushing On.'

4d33fae4bb60.curator_note: An open-to-close booking from an Innervisions/Watergate name is the kind of set where the arc matters more than any single hour — Gin Ling Way's alley setting should suit his deeper, jazzier register.
4d33fae4bb60.description: Swiss house/disco producer Jimi Jules (Innervisions, longtime Watergate resident) plays a rare open-to-close set at Gin Ling Way in Chinatown (Sat 9/26).

artist_notes.name: Daphni

1d9a326d562d.curator_note: Daphni isn't a side-project curiosity — it's Caribou's Dan Snaith building tracks specifically for a dancefloor, and he almost never plays full all-night sets; this is the rare chance to hear it stretched out instead of a festival hour.

artist_notes.note: Jazz vocalist who took over Marty & Elayne's four-decade Dresden residency with co-host Jesse Goddard — an LA Times 'essential' pick for live jazz in LA.

artist_notes.note: The Dresden's house bandleader — his trio anchors the venue's biweekly no-cover jazz/crooner nights alongside rotating singers.

694730c59c72.curator_note: Forbes and Goddard picked up the Marty & Elayne torch here, and it shows — legit old-Hollywood standards with Moscoe's trio holding it down behind them; free and low-stakes, good for an easy Friday.

artist_notes.name: Rrose
artist_notes.note: US techno producer/performer known for hypnotic, physically intense techno (Eaux, Stroboscopic Artefacts orbit) — one of the more respected voices in abstract, mind-bending techno right now.

artist_notes.name: Wata Igarashi
artist_notes.note: Tokyo-based producer whose cerebral, psychedelic, hypnotic techno (Midgar Records) has made him a genuinely in-demand international touring name.

artist_notes.name: Marrøn
artist_notes.note: Jessey Voorn — Dutch/Surinamese DJ known for rhythmic, tribal-inflected techno pulling on African percussion; co-founder/resident of Amsterdam's EERSTE COMMUNIE.

artist_notes.name: Rene Wise
artist_notes.note: Brighton-born, Portugal-based DJ/producer (Mote-Evolver, his own Moving Pressure label) — hypnotic, groovy, rolling 90s-leaning techno; backed by Rødhad, Blawan and DVS1.

artist_notes.name: Sarah Wreath
artist_notes.note: Berlin-based sound artist and live techno producer — deep, psychedelic, hypnotic sets; debut LP 'Integration' on The Bunker New York, plus a Sandwell District collaboration.

artist_notes.name: JIA
artist_notes.note: Founder of 6AM Group and co-founder of LA's RE/FORM Festival — a connector/promoter as much as a DJ, with residencies at Factory 93 and Beyond Wonderland.

artist_notes.name: NEKTER
artist_notes.note: LA-based techno DJ, 2021 REFORM DJ Contest winner (6AM Group/Synthetik Minds) — resident at WORK LA, playing hypnotic, texture-heavy techno sets.

b534e6601fbb.curator_note: Rrose and Wata Igarashi alone are worth clearing a night for — two of the most respected names in hypnotic, physically-heavy techno right now — and stacking them with Marrøn's tribal groove plus the 6AM/WORK locals makes this the real deep-cut booking of the weekend, TBA location and marathon Friday-into-Sunday runtime included.
b534e6601fbb.description: An extended TBA-location afterhours techno session (Fri 11pm into Sunday morning) from 6AM Group and Synthetik Minds, headlined by Rrose and Wata Igarashi alongside Marrøn, Rene Wise, Sarah Wreath, JIA and NEKTER.

sounds_like: hypnotic, dense techno in the Inner Tension/SXTCY mold

artist_notes.name: Anastasia Giovani
artist_notes.note: LA underground techno regular — SXTCY resident known for dark, raw, propulsive sets; also runs VSCRL, a modular/vinyl/noise-leaning event series.

artist_notes.name: Blazej Malinowski
artist_notes.note: Polish, Berlin-based techno producer — founder of the Inner Tension label, deep and hypnotic productions on Semantica and Silent Season.

artist_notes.name: Kameliia
artist_notes.note: Oslo-based techno DJ (Bulgarian-born) — self-described 'mental techno,' driving and atmospheric, releases on Token and SK_eleven; has played Berghain, Fold and Berlin Atonal.

artist_notes.name: Secus
artist_notes.note: LA techno producer (Matt Salamone) — half of Motionen, co-founder of label Ascetic Limited; jazz/metal-informed, hard and agitated techno.

5d50585cdb35.curator_note: A legit deep-techno afterhours booking — Berlin's Blazej Malinowski and Oslo's Kameliia flying in alongside LA's own Anastasia Giovani and Secus for a 5am TBA start. Hypnotic, dense end of the spectrum, not big-room — worth it only if you're actually built for a real after-hours.
5d50585cdb35.description: TBA-location LA techno afterhours (5am start) — SYNTHESIS's second edition pairs Berlin's Blazej Malinowski and Oslo's Kameliia with LA regulars Anastasia Giovani and Secus.

artist_notes.name: 54 Ultra
artist_notes.note: New Jersey singer-songwriter John Rodriguez — garage-pop and Latin-soul-inflected indie, recently the featured vocal on ANOTR's disco-house single 'Talk to You'; the one genuinely dance-adjacent surprise on the rock side of this bill.

artist_notes.name: SG Lewis
artist_notes.note: British DJ/producer/songwriter — warm, disco-etched dance-pop (albums 'times', 'AudioLust & HigherLove'); has written and produced with Dua Lipa, Robyn and Nile Rodgers.

artist_notes.name: Hot Chip
artist_notes.note: Long-running London electronic band (since 2000, early DFA ties) — dance-rock/electropop ('Over and Over,' 'Ready For The Floor') with a big, festival-tested live show.

artist_notes.name: Austin Millz
artist_notes.note: Harlem-raised, NYC-based DJ/producer blending hip-hop with dance/house — DJ'd Beyoncé's 'Homecoming' Coachella sets and played Boiler Room NYC.

artist_notes.name: Nala
artist_notes.note: LA-via-Miami producer/DJ (Stefania Aronin) — acid house and indie-dance with a punky, off-kilter edge; Dirtybird signee and Lights Down Low resident who runs the label Mi Domina.

96782c900568.curator_note: The headliners (Killers, Jack White, Sublime) are the reason to buy a ticket, but don't sleep on the DJ stage — DJ Harvey and Hot Chip DJs playing a beach day is genuinely the rooftop-groove energy you like, just with sand instead of a roof.
96782c900568.description: Ocean Way Festival takes over The Beach at Santa Monica with The Killers, Jack White, Sublime and Alvvays headlining alongside a DJ stage (DJ Harvey, Hot Chip DJs, SG Lewis, Austin Millz, Nala, 54 Ultra).

artist_notes.name: David Moscoe
artist_notes.note: The Dresden's house bandleader — his trio anchors the venue's biweekly no-cover jazz/crooner nights alongside rotating singers.

99ae9921769c.curator_note: Same dependable Dresden quartet doing its regular thing — pleasant background-to-foreground jazz for a Los Feliz Saturday, nothing to build a night around.
99ae9921769c.description: Weekly no-cover instrumental jazz quartet led by David Moscoe with rotating guests at The Dresden, 9:15pm-12:15am.

artist_notes.name: Jen Cardini
artist_notes.note: Jennifer Cardini — French-born, Berlin-based house/techno DJ, 30 years in, founder of the Correspondant label (grew out of her Rex Club Paris residency, now Kompakt-distributed) spanning deep house, Italo, cosmic disco and techno.

artist_notes.name: Konduku
artist_notes.note: Ruben Üvez — Dutch producer based in Berlin, releases on Nous'klaer Audio and Delsin — hypnotic, detail-heavy techno with a UK bass-culture streak; a selector's selector, not a big-room name.

artist_notes.name: Buttechno
artist_notes.note: Pavel Milyakov — Moscow underground fixture (John's Kingdom collective, tight with Gost Zvuk and Klasse Wrecks) making spacious, dystopian techno; this is a live set, not a DJ set.

dadf61c46a60.curator_note: This is the real deal — Jen Cardini's Correspondant/Rex Club pedigree, Buttechno bringing his raw Moscow techno live, and Konduku's hypnotic, UK-bass-inflected style, all in a TBA DTLA warehouse running to 5am. About as close to a proper European club night as LA gets.
dadf61c46a60.description: DTLA warehouse afters (9pm–5am) with French house/techno veteran Jen Cardini, Dutch-Berlin producer Konduku, Moscow techno artist Buttechno (live), and Rachana.

dae326a7e622.description: Electronic night at El Cid (10pm, Silver Lake) with Hu Dat.

5f03f3359f7a.curator_note: The Flea's mid-2026 move from Micheltorena to Atwater is still fresh — same indie vintage/vinyl/handmade mix, worth double-checking the new hours before you go.
5f03f3359f7a.description: Indie vintage, vinyl, and handmade market, relocated in 2026 from Silver Lake to Atwater Village; free entry and parking.

a56909f59a60.description: Phoebe Ryan live show at The Moroccan Lounge in the Arts District (doors 6:30pm, $25–30 GA / $75 VIP, 21+).

artist_notes.name: Tritonal
artist_notes.note: American trance/progressive-house duo (Chad Cisneros & Dave Reed) on Enhanced/Armada — real festival-circuit history (EDC, Ultra) and a long-running radio show, more big-room anthem than club groove.

artist_notes.name: Sean Rowe
artist_notes.note: Troy, NY singer-songwriter on Anti- Records since 2010 — a booming, weathered baritone the Wall Street Journal compares to Leonard Cohen; alt-folk/Americana built for a small room like this.

artist_notes.name: Swimming Bell
artist_notes.note: Alt-folk project with a hazy, mid-'70s Laurel Canyon-leaning sound — thin footprint beyond that, but a plausible, complementary opener for Rowe's stripped-down Americana.

012ef9a230d8.curator_note: Sean Rowe's gravel-baritone alt-folk (the Leonard Cohen comparisons are earned) in the small back room at Permanent Records Roadhouse is a good, low-key night — the small indie/rock club show worth building an evening around.
012ef9a230d8.description: Alt-folk singer-songwriter Sean Rowe (Anti- Records) plays Permanent Records Roadhouse with support from Swimming Bell.

41c7b2f338e3.curator_note: No verifiable info on this Silverados/Lucky Me bill beyond the venue — Permanent Records Roadhouse is a reliable room, but there's nothing here to point to as a reason to prioritize the night.
41c7b2f338e3.description: The Silverados and Lucky Me play Permanent Records Roadhouse, 9pm, $5 advance / $10 door.

artist_notes.name: SG Lewis
artist_notes.note: British DJ/producer/songwriter — warm, disco-etched dance-pop (albums 'times', 'AudioLust & HigherLove'); has written and produced with Dua Lipa, Robyn and Nile Rodgers.

artist_notes.name: Hot Chip
artist_notes.note: Long-running London electronic band (since 2000, early DFA ties) — dance-rock/electropop ('Over and Over,' 'Ready For The Floor') with a big, festival-tested live show.

artist_notes.name: Austin Millz
artist_notes.note: Harlem-raised, NYC-based DJ/producer blending hip-hop with dance/house — DJ'd Beyoncé's 'Homecoming' Coachella sets and played Boiler Room NYC.

artist_notes.name: Nala
artist_notes.note: LA-via-Miami producer/DJ (Stefania Aronin) — acid house and indie-dance with a punky, off-kilter edge; Dirtybird signee and Lights Down Low resident who runs the label Mi Domina.

artist_notes.name: Blond:ish
artist_notes.note: Canadian-Swiss duo (Anstascia, Vivie-Ann) — melodic/organic house with an eco-conscious rave ethos; co-founded the No.19 Music label.

artist_notes.name: Poolside
artist_notes.note: LA duo (Filip Nikolic, Jeffrey Paradise) who more or less invented 'daytime disco' — slow-motion, sun-baked grooves ('Harvest Moon,' 'Do You Believe'). About as squarely built for a beach day as it gets.

artist_notes.name: Vandelux
artist_notes.note: Vancouver-born, SF-based producer/vocalist (Evan White) — groove-driven electronic/soul/indie; 'Matter of Time' charted on Billboard Dance.

artist_notes.name: Good Neighbours
artist_notes.note: UK indie-pop duo (Oli Fox, Scott Verrill) behind 2024's viral hit 'Home' — tropical-leaning, early-2000s-indie-indebted pop, more festival crossover than club.

1d2529b6944a.curator_note: DJ Harvey, Poolside and Blond:ish give this real disco/house teeth, but Hot Chip, SG Lewis and Good Neighbours pull it toward general-festival territory rather than a pure dance lineup — go for the beach-day format and the top of the bill, not expecting a club night.
1d2529b6944a.description: Two-day beach festival at Santa Monica Beach (Sat noon–Sun 10pm) mixing disco/house (DJ Harvey, Poolside, Blond:ish, Carlita) with dance-pop and indie names (Hot Chip, SG Lewis, Good Neighbours).

artist_notes.name: Momo Trosman
artist_notes.note: Buenos Aires-born DJ/producer, DJing professionally since 2011 with European tours behind him — dub- and jazz-informed digging across UK/US house, electro and techno; co-runs the Cure Music label.

artist_notes.name: Cromie
artist_notes.note: Zagreb-born, LA-based producer — Balearic-fringe house: crisp grooves, warm melodies and hazy breaks, released via Amadeus Records and Duality Trax.

e0bf9830cfa7.curator_note: This is the TBA-warehouse afterhours format Ari already likes, and the lineup is a notch deeper than most of them — Momo Trosman and Cromie are legit diggers, not just names filling a flyer.
e0bf9830cfa7.description: TBA-location DTLA afterhours (10pm-8am) with tech-house/breaks selectors Gene On Earth, Momo Trosman, Cromie, Chemtrail Johnny, Hazy, Ian Llorens and Gilbert0.

artist_notes.name: Mark Farina
artist_notes.note: Chicago-born, SF-based house legend behind the long-running 'Mushroom Jazz' series — a jazzy, downtempo-inflected strain of house he's been refining since the mid-90s.

artist_notes.name: Josh Wink
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia techno/house legend ('Higher State of Consciousness') and Ovum Recordings co-founder since 1994 — still a headline-level booking three decades in.

artist_notes.name: DJ Dazy
artist_notes.note: LA house DJ since 1992 — founded the all-female Sister DJs collective, deep and soulful vinyl-rooted sets, part of the West Coast house lineage this bill leans on.

artist_notes.name: Your Unkle Magik
artist_notes.note: Vinyl-only house selector, a regular on the Certified Groovers/DTLA open-air circuit.

artist_notes.name: Tom Carle
artist_notes.note: LA underground DJ working deep/minimal tech-house and techno — longtime host of a DJ podcast since 2018, regular alongside DJ Sneak and J-Dub on the CHI♡LA circuit.

4ecd0fcd718a.curator_note: A three-day house marathon built around DJ Sneak's birthday with Derrick Carter, Mark Farina and Josh Wink on the bill — this is Chicago-house royalty depth you don't see stacked this thick very often, TBA location aside.
4ecd0fcd718a.description: Multi-day (Sat 4pm–Mon 2am) house celebration for DJ Sneak's birthday, TBA location, with Derrick Carter, Mark Farina, Josh Wink, DJ Heather, John Tejada and a deep bench of Chicago-rooted house DJs.

artist_notes.name: Oppidan
artist_notes.note: UK garage producer, one of the faster-rising names in the current UKG wave — blends 2-step with 4x4 NUKG and bass; a genre pick rather than a straight house/techno booking.

5360e31e4b2e.curator_note: A solo headline set from a rising UK garage name — good if you want UKG specifically, but it's a headliner-only booking at Academy with no support billed yet.
5360e31e4b2e.description: Solo headline set from UK garage producer Oppidan at Academy LA.

artist_notes.name: Will Varley
artist_notes.note: UK folk-punk singer-songwriter on Xtra Mile Recordings, part of the Frank Turner touring orbit — wry, road-worn acoustic songs, a real name in that scene.

artist_notes.name: Beans on Toast
artist_notes.note: UK folk singer (Jay McAllister) famous for releasing an album every birthday since 2009 — dry, talking-blues folk, another Xtra Mile/Frank Turner-circle regular.

dcbaf0b6e7a5.curator_note: Two real UK folk-punk road warriors, both Xtra Mile/Frank Turner-orbit, sharing a tiny Cypress Park stage for $15 — the kind of 'why isn't this a bigger room' booking worth catching.

artist_notes.name: Friendship Commanders

artist_notes.name: Doomboyz
artist_notes.note: LA stoner/doom rock band whose 2024 debut 'Evil Riffs From Los Angeles' was tracked at the Foo Fighters' Studio 606 and got Grammy Best Rock Album consideration.

e5dc854a8740.curator_note: Both bands on top have real pedigree — Friendship Commanders had a record cut by Steve Albini, and Doomboyz tracked their debut at the Foo Fighters' own Studio 606. Heavier and louder than most of the docket, but a legit doom/sludge bill.

artist_notes.name: Richie Hawtin
artist_notes.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno.

artist_notes.name: Cloonee
artist_notes.note: Manchester-raised tech-house producer Dave Bissett (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s including 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab 'Nightmares'; one of the circuit's best crowd-movers.

artist_notes.name: DJ Tennis
artist_notes.note: Manfredi Romano — Italian scene godfather who founded Life and Death in 2010 (Tale Of Us, Mind Against and Carlita all came up through the label); a globally touring, melodic house/techno selector.

fc02f613287a.curator_note: Insomniac's Halloween mega-fest buries real house/techno headliners — Hawtin, Kraviz, Capriati, DJ Tennis, Jamie Jones — under a dozen stages of hardstyle, dubstep, and bass. Worth it for a specific set, not for the vibe of the thing as a whole.
fc02f613287a.description: Insomniac's Halloween festival at NOS Events Center in San Bernardino, spanning house/techno headliners (Richie Hawtin, Nina Kraviz, Joseph Capriati) alongside trance, dubstep, and hardstyle stages.

artist_notes.name: Ferry Corsten
artist_notes.note: Dutch trance OG since the late-90s boom (System F, Gouryella with a young Tiësto) who now runs his own Flashover label and plays a broader, more contemporary progressive-leaning set.

artist_notes.name: Artbat
artist_notes.note: Ukrainian duo (Artur Kryvenko & Vitalii Limarenko) — melodic techno breakout via Solomun's Diynamic label ('Upperground', 'Atlas'); one of the names most responsible for melodic techno's mainstream crossover.

artist_notes.name: Enrico Sangiuliano
artist_notes.note: Italian techno producer, one of Drumcode's biggest-selling artists for a stretch (Adam Beyer's label) — hypnotic, sci-fi-tinged peak-time techno built for big rooms.

artist_notes.name: BT
artist_notes.note: Brian Transeau — one of American trance's founding names since the late-90s, still touring a big, cinematic, melody-forward sound.

0805854dd8f8.curator_note: Trance is mostly outside the lane, but this is the genre's biggest annual SoCal gathering, and Artbat and Enrico Sangiuliano's melodic-techno sets are a real reason to go beyond nostalgia for Above & Beyond and Ferry Corsten.
0805854dd8f8.description: Insomniac's SoCal trance festival, headlined by Above & Beyond and Ferry Corsten with melodic-techno crossover sets from Artbat and Enrico Sangiuliano.

bcbe10ce2a88.curator_note: No lineup posted yet for this Halloween-week booking — 1720 is a dependable warehouse-techno room, but hard to rate blind at $46.
bcbe10ce2a88.description: Halloween-week party at 1720 in the Arts District; lineup not yet announced.

artist_notes.name: yaego
artist_notes.note: PG County, Maryland-raised producer blending dark, melodic house with cinematic build — a fast-rising TikTok/SoundCloud name ('Fe en Rebelion,' 'HARDX') more than an established club headliner yet.

02d774d6c10a.curator_note: Lights Down Low is one of LA's most dependable underground house/techno series — worth going for the room and crowd even though yaego is more a rising internet-native name than a proven headliner.
02d774d6c10a.description: Lights Down Low's recurring DTLA warehouse night featuring rising dark-melodic house producer yaego.

artist_notes.name: KlangKuenstler
artist_notes.note: German techno producer (Michael Korb) who built his own Outworld and Zuckerton Records imprints — matured from deep/tech house into hard, acid- and trance-tinged peak-time techno; co-runs the label Tote Sonne with Kobosil.

d1f48078ca56.curator_note: This is his own Outworld imprint's night — a full-arena solo all-night set is a rare format for an artist at this level, though the sound is heavier and more peak-time than the rooftop-vinyl end of the lane.
d1f48078ca56.description: German techno producer KlangKuenstler (Outworld, Zuckerton Records) plays an all-night solo set for Factory 93 at The Forum.

ef975e4e6dac.description: Instrumental jazz quartet with rotating guests at The Dresden (9:15pm, no cover).

artist_notes.name: DjRUM
artist_notes.note: Felix Manuel, London — jazz-trained producer/DJ (R&S, Ilian Tape) whose all-vinyl, three-turntable sets weave techno, breaks, jungle and ambient into something narrative rather than functional. A genuinely rare, extended (4hr) booking, not a standard tour stop.

artist_notes.name: Mark Ernestus
artist_notes.note: Berlin legend — founder of the Hard Wax record shop and one half of Basic Channel/Rhythm & Sound, the duo who invented dub techno. Now runs Ndagga Rhythm Force, fusing that lineage with Senegalese mbalax. A living-history booking that almost never comes through LA; his 3-hour set alone justifies the day.

artist_notes.name: Akanbi
artist_notes.note: Lagos-raised, NY-based DJ (GROOVY GROOVY founder) known for blending tough club rhythms into amapiano and Afro-adjacent sounds before hard turns into techno — the amapiano/bass-music strand on this bill.

artist_notes.name: The Large
artist_notes.note: NYC-scene selector, regularly paired with Akanbi (GROOVY GROOVY, Brooklyn) on amapiano/dancehall/afrobeats-leaning closing sets.

ac41ac86343d.curator_note: Mark Ernestus playing a 3-hour set in LA is not a normal occurrence — he's the co-inventor of dub techno and almost never tours this way — and pairing him with DjRUM's all-vinyl marathon plus Akanbi b2b The Large's amapiano-leaning closer makes this the single most genuinely rare booking in this batch. Extended sets across the board; worth clearing the whole day for.
ac41ac86343d.description: CSW's afternoon-to-3am open-air in DTLA: Basic Channel co-founder Mark Ernestus (3hr), all-vinyl selector DjRUM (4hr), and Akanbi b2b The Large (double set), spanning techno, dub, breaks, dnb and amapiano.

artist_notes.name: Yellow Shoots
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn multi-instrumentalist (Gregory Matthews) making genre-bending psych/R&B — warm, off-kilter soul rather than a straight rock bill.

artist_notes.name: Kevin Roosevelt
artist_notes.note: LA-born R&B artist (son of Keb' Mo') who's charted on the R&B charts and collaborated with Jhené Aiko and Rapsody — a real name playing a small room.

48cdb369b892.curator_note: Not the usual Roadhouse punk bill — Yellow Shoots' psych-soul and Kevin Roosevelt's charted R&B pedigree make this a genuinely good, low-key catch for the price of admission.
48cdb369b892.description: Brooklyn psych-soul artist Yellow Shoots headlines with LA R&B artist Kevin Roosevelt at Permanent Records Roadhouse.

08d19bc594db.curator_note: A stacked bass/dubstep bill at 1720 — outside the house-techno lane entirely, more useful as an 'around town' data point than something to prioritize.

artist_notes.name: Anfisa Letyago
artist_notes.note: Naples-scene-turned-global techno DJ/producer (Russian-born, Italy-based) — hypnotic, groove-driven techno/house; Moby tapped her for a 2022 'Go' remix, and she runs her own label N:S:DA.

04471a755954.curator_note: A real international techno headliner landing in a proper DTLA room on her own night, not sharing a festival stage — worth the Saturday if you're in a techno mood.
04471a755954.description: Solo headline techno set from Italy-based DJ/producer Anfisa Letyago at Exchange LA.

artist_notes.name: Luke Strand
artist_notes.note: Bay Area-raised, LA-based vocalist/multi-instrumentalist (bass, guitar, keys, trumpet) who teaches at Musicians Institute Hollywood — leads this free weekly soul/jazz/R&B hang covering decades of hits with a rotating band.

087184be27c5.curator_note: A free weekly jam-session hang, not a headline show — good for a walk-in Los Feliz night if you're already out, not for building plans around.
087184be27c5.description: No-cover weekly soul/jazz jam session at The Dresden led by vocalist-multi-instrumentalist Luke Strand, with rotating guest musicians (8:30pm).

artist_notes.name: Brijean
artist_notes.note: Oakland duo (Brijean Murphy & Doug Stuart) on Ghostly International — Murphy is also the touring percussionist for Poolside and Toro y Moi; their own sound is warm, congas-driven boogie/dream-pop. This is a DJ set, not the live band, so expect disco/house selections in that same breezy register.

0ec47193d563.curator_note: Brijean behind the decks rather than behind the congas is a nice change of format — her Ghostly/Poolside pedigree suggests a warm, disco-leaning selection for a Halloween night at Camille's.
0ec47193d563.description: Halloween DJ set (disco/house/pop) from Ghostly International duo Brijean at The Bellwether's Camille's night.

artist_notes.name: Giegling
artist_notes.note: The Weimar, Germany label/collective (Traumprinz aka DJ Metatron, Konstantin/Kettenkarussell, Vril, HVL and others) behind some of the most mythologized, hypnotic house and techno of the last decade — genuinely rare to see a Giegling-branded date in LA, though the listing doesn't say which member of the crew is actually playing.

0fb32652872c.curator_note: A Giegling booking in LA is unusual enough to flag even without knowing which artist from the crew is actually behind the decks — TBA location and a 6am run time both point to the real afterhours version of this, from the same Midnight Lovers crew as Masha Mar's other nights.
0fb32652872c.description: Halloween afterhours party (TBA DTLA location, 11pm-6am) presented by Midnight Lovers under the Giegling banner.

artist_notes.name: Kids in America
artist_notes.note: Touring '80s new-wave/pop tribute band (originally out of Charlotte, NC) covering hits from the decade — not an original act, so genre is pop covers rather than the venue's usual punk/rock.

10e5a0affe9c.curator_note: This is the touring '80s tribute act, not a real band — right in the cover-band/nostalgia-night bucket the taste profile skips regardless of venue.
10e5a0affe9c.description: Touring '80s new-wave/pop tribute band 'Kids in America' plays Permanent Records Roadhouse with a special-guest opener.

artist_notes.name: Sub Imperium
artist_notes.note: Producer on Occult Rhythms and Askorn Records — labels built around hard, dark, EBM-tinged techno; rougher and more industrial than the refined European techno lane.

1349d815db60.curator_note: Sub Imperium is a real name in the dark/industrial-techno underground, and the 'Final Communion' framing suggests this could be closing out the Solitary Gardens series — worth noting even though the genre (EBM/industrial) sits a notch harder than the usual pick.
1349d815db60.description: Dark techno/EBM/industrial night at 1720 headlined by Sub Imperium, part of the 'Solitary Gardens: Final Communion Rave' series, 9pm-2am.

16fbd16dcbe0.curator_note: Luke Strand's a legit working musician, but this is a no-cover, low-stakes jam-session night — pleasant if you're already at the Dresden, not something to route a night around.
16fbd16dcbe0.description: No-cover soulful jazz jam session led by vocalist/multi-instrumentalist Luke Strand at The Dresden.

1dad82afaaaa.description: Recurring 'Swingin' Jazz Affair' crooner night at The Dresden — Matt Forbes and Jesse Goddard with the David Moscoe Trio.

artist_notes.note: Berlin techno pioneer and BPitch Control label founder since the '90s — raw, physical, art-damaged techno; about as European-scene as a booking gets.

artist_notes.name: Effy
artist_notes.note: UK (Blackpool/London) DJ-producer doing druggy acid techno and classic-house revivalism — has opened for Helena Hauff, Scuba, Honey Dijon and Peggy Gou.

artist_notes.name: Johnny_Health
artist_notes.note: LA underground rave-circuit DJ (Hood Rave/Hellraiser-type parties) — thin bio beyond a busy local DJ résumé.

9b042b535907.curator_note: Ellen Allien and Avalon Emerson on the same Halloween bill is a real techno booking, not a costume-party gimmick — and Lights Down Low's own crew (Richie Panic, Corey Sizemore) plus Sextile's DJ set keep it weird instead of trick-or-treat cute.
9b042b535907.description: Lights Down Low's Halloween all-nighter (TBA location, 9pm-4am) stacks Berlin techno legend Ellen Allien and Avalon Emerson with Sextile's DJ set and the LDL residents.

artist_notes.name: Lens
artist_notes.note: Brighton drum & bass DJ-producer, Hospital Records mainstay and host of their Rinse FM show — known for dynamic double-drops and eclectic selection; released on Spearhead too.

c26fdb8d7933.curator_note: Lens has become one of Hospital Records' go-to voices — a genuinely dynamic double-drop DnB set if that's a lane you want to step into for a night at 1720.
c26fdb8d7933.description: UK drum & bass DJ/producer Lens (Hospital Records, Rinse FM) plays 1720 in the Arts District, 9pm-2am.

artist_notes.name: Maiya Sykes
artist_notes.note: LA vocalist — Voice Season 7 alum, backing-vocal credits for Black Eyed Peas, Macy Gray, Michael Bublé and Rita Ora, featured vocals in 'La La Land'; a genuinely good voice, not just a novelty booking.

02e0d05c2daf.curator_note: This is Maiya Sykes' third annual Monster Mash, so it's a known quantity — but she's got real credentials (La La Land backing vocals, the Bublé touring circuit) doing costumed jazz/funk/disco sets in a proper jazz room. Fun, not essential.
02e0d05c2daf.description: Vocalist Maiya Sykes' third annual Halloween costume party — jazz, funk and disco sets, two shows (7pm & 9:30pm) at Vibrato Grill Jazz.

artist_notes.name: SHERELLE
artist_notes.note: London 160bpm force spinning footwork, jungle and dnb — co-founded Hooversound and runs the Black/queer-focused label Beautiful; a fabric/Boiler Room-tier name, not a house purist but a real international draw.

artist_notes.name: Pangaea
artist_notes.note: UK producer, co-founder of Hessle Audio (with Ben UFO, Pearson Sound) — bass-schooled techno that fits the fabric-London end of the lane.

artist_notes.name: Danny Daze
artist_notes.note: Miami techno/house producer on Omnidisc and Crosstown Rebels — respected selector on the US underground club circuit.

artist_notes.name: Mia Koden
artist_notes.note: South London producer/DJ, half of Sicaria Sound, working the 140bpm dub/garage/steppers space — released on Ilian Tape, RA's 2024 Breakthrough Artist.

b325f3896433.curator_note: SHERELLE at 160bpm next to Todd Edwards' skippy garage and Pangaea's bass-techno makes this a genuinely eclectic booking, closer to a UK festival stage than an average Silver Lake house night.

artist_notes.name: Marques Wyatt
artist_notes.note: West Coast deep house legend — ran LA's long-running Deep party/residency from the late '90s into the 2010s and is generally credited with helping put LA's dance scene on the map alongside NYC and Miami.

artist_notes.name: Doc Martin
artist_notes.note: West Coast house pioneer — moved SF to LA in the early '90s, founded the long-running Sublevel label/party (25 years deep in 2026); deep, tribal, acid-inflected house from a genuine scene elder.

artist_notes.name: David Harness
artist_notes.note: Bay Area deep-house DJ/producer/remixer (credits with Mary J. Blige, Alicia Keys) — soulful, classic house across Coachella, Glastonbury and beyond.

artist_notes.name: Big Cee
artist_notes.note: Chris Legaspi — the longtime resident opening DJ at Marques Wyatt's DEEP, a foundational figure in LA's house community who's shared decks with Frankie Knuckles and Louie Vega.

artist_notes.name: SEEPS
artist_notes.note: Bronx-born, LA-based DJ steeped in NYC's '90s golden-era house and disco/boogie — has drawn attention from Louie Vega and DJ Sneak.

5ca17cfc7795.curator_note: Marques Wyatt and Doc Martin are the two guys most responsible for LA having a real deep-house scene in the first place, and a b2b between them at an open-air DTLA plaza with Big Cee and SEEPS behind them is about as authentic as this town's house lineage gets.
5ca17cfc7795.description: Outdoor day party (1pm-9pm) at California Plaza with LA deep-house legends Marques Wyatt b2b Doc Martin, plus David Harness, Big Cee and SEEPS.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

artist_notes.name: Marc Homer
artist_notes.note: Berlin-based DJ/producer (formerly LA/NYC) and Half & 1/2 label owner — a Gegen and HÖR regular playing techno, club, breaks, baile and ballroom; cites SOPHIE and Aphex Twin as touchstones.

artist_notes.name: Narciss
artist_notes.note: Unverified which artist of this name is booked — there's a Berlin-based melodic-techno/trance producer (Running Back, Lobster Theremin) and a separate Timișoara, Romania techno DJ sharing the alias; treat with low confidence.

912b65709d9c.curator_note: Masha Mar's Italo-disco pedigree and Marc Homer's Berlin queer-club chops (Gegen, HÖR) make this a legitimately deep-in-the-scene WORK afterhours booking, even with the venue still TBA and one name on the bill (Narciss) impossible to pin down for sure.
912b65709d9c.description: WORK's TBA-location afterhours with Narciss, Masha Mar and Marc Homer, 11pm start.

artist_notes.name: Samuel Moriero
artist_notes.note: Young Italian hard-techno DJ/producer riding a fast rise on the European underground circuit — raw, industrial-driven, neo-rave sound; a 2025 Marnik collab ('Hard Techno') got real festival pickup. This is his first LA date.

ba7cf6f43291.curator_note: Samuel Moriero is a genuinely buzzy young name on the European hard-techno circuit making his actual LA debut, but it's the harder, faster, more industrial cousin of the refined techno lane you usually go for, not a substitute for it.
ba7cf6f43291.description: LA debut of Italian hard-techno riser Samuel Moriero at 1720 Warehouse, presented by WA$TED x Trinity (18+, doors 9pm).

artist_notes.name: O.B.I.
artist_notes.note: German hard-techno veteran of 20+ years, runs his own Definition of Hard Techno label — rough, industrial-edged hard techno, not the melodic/peak-time end.

artist_notes.name: Per Pleks
artist_notes.note: Dortmund-based schranz/hard-techno producer who topped Beatport's Hard Techno chart in 2023 — a rising name in the harder German scene.

e65210096485.curator_note: O.B.I. and Per Pleks are both real, respected schranz/hard-techno names — legit if you want the harder, more relentless cousin of the refined European techno you usually chase, but it's a noticeably rougher, faster sound than what's typically on-lane here.
e65210096485.description: Hard-techno/schranz co-headline set from O.B.I. and Per Pleks at 1720 Warehouse, presented by WA$TED x Trinity (18+, doors 9pm).

artist_notes.name: Matt Forbes
artist_notes.note: Jazz vocalist who took over Marty & Elayne's four-decade Dresden residency with co-host Jesse Goddard — an LA Times 'essential' pick for live jazz in LA.

artist_notes.name: David Moscoe
artist_notes.note: The Dresden's house bandleader — his trio anchors the venue's biweekly no-cover jazz/crooner nights alongside rotating singers.

dae79844974a.curator_note: Forbes and Goddard carrying the Marty & Elayne torch is the whole draw here — legit old-Hollywood standards with Moscoe's trio behind them, free and low-stakes for an easy night in Los Feliz.
dae79844974a.description: No-cover 'Old Hollywood' crooner night at The Dresden — Matt Forbes and Jesse Goddard front the David Moscoe Trio, 9:15pm.

artist_notes.name: The Killing Floors
artist_notes.note: LA five-piece rock 'n' roll band built on 60s garage and punk influences — Music Connection named them one of the Top 100 Live Performers.

artist_notes.name: The Street Walkin' Cheetahs
artist_notes.note: Veteran LA punk/hard-rock band (named for the Stooges' "Search and Destroy"), fronted by Frank Meyer, with members who've shared stages with Radio Birdman's Deniz Tek, MC5's Wayne Kramer, and the New York Dolls' Sylvain Sylvain — real proto-punk lineage, not a tribute act.

4d445ec38578.curator_note: A legitimately stacked garage-punk bill for ten bucks — the Streetwalkin' Cheetahs carry real Stooges/MC5-adjacent pedigree, and the Killing Floors are a real Top 100 live act in their own right.
4d445ec38578.description: Garage-punk and rock 'n' roll triple bill — The Killing Floors, The Street Walkin' Cheetahs, and The Strains — at Permanent Records Roadhouse.

e6b0885ec969.description: Hard techno with Hhunter, Nina J, masato at 1720 warehouse, Arts District (9pm-2am, $14-22).

artist_notes.name: Kyle Watson
artist_notes.note: Johannesburg-raised, now-touring tech-house producer — co-owner of the bass-leaning Box of Cats label, with festival slots at Ultra, EDC and Lollapalooza. Jacking, peak-time tech-house rather than a deep/vinyl selector.

e38ca867c0c2.curator_note: Kyle Watson is a legitimate mainstream tech-house name with real Ultra/EDC pedigree — this is the big-room, festival-adjacent end of the lane rather than a discovery, but it's a genuine headliner at Exchange's scale of room.
e38ca867c0c2.description: Tech-house/funky-house residency night '360' with Kyle Watson at Exchange LA, DTLA (10pm-3am, $15).

artist_notes.name: HHUNTER
artist_notes.note: Chicago producer/DJ on the rise in industrial/hard techno — self-taught, has picked up support slots for Sara Landry, Indira Paganotto and Hiroko Yamamura. artist_notes.name: Juliet Mendoza
artist_notes.note: LA-native house DJ and dancer — founder/resident of Jill's House (Jackin Jills), a Defected 'Unsung Heroes' alum; melodic, soulful, deep house rooted in the city's Black/Latin house dance lineage.

artist_notes.name: Spiñorita
artist_notes.note: Angela Ramirez — Alhambra-raised Chicana DJ and host of NTS's Casual Play; disco, house, funk and vinyl-digging roots, a fixture of LA's underground/backyard party scene since 2010.

artist_notes.name: SEEPS
artist_notes.note: Bronx-born, LA-based DJ steeped in NYC's '90s golden-era house and disco/boogie — has drawn attention from Louie Vega and DJ Sneak.

artist_notes.name: Guaparda
artist_notes.note: Estefanía Gallo-Gonzalez (aka Langosta) — LA-based singer, DJ and dublab radio host currently studying to be a music librarian/archivist; house-leaning selections, releases via the dottidot orbit.

artist_notes.name: Andy Oro
artist_notes.note: LA DJ, host of the Oro Hour on VPN Radio and a Made to Move resident — eclectic underground/house sets pulling from DIY dance music, hip-hop and bloghouse.

28bd6f6d692d.curator_note: Made to Move's women-DJ showcase back at the Airliner on the 25th — Spiñorita's NTS pedigree and Juliet Mendoza's Jill's House lineage make this a real digging crowd, not a themed flyer with filler names. Cheap, close, bar-scale — not a big night out, but an honest one.
28bd6f6d692d.description: Made to Move's 'Latinas in the House' night at The Airliner (Lincoln Heights), spotlighting women DJs Juliet Mendoza, Spiñorita, SEEPS, Guaparda and Andy Oro across house, disco and funk selections (8pm-2am, free before 8:30).

sounds_like: Cell Injection's raw, stripped-down techno lineage

artist_notes.name: Chris Liebing
artist_notes.note: German techno veteran since the early-'90s Frankfurt scene, founder of the purist techno label/podcast CLR — a genuine headline-tier name (Awakenings, Time Warp) known for dark, driving, relentless sets; a 5-hour set is a real event, not a normal tour-stop hour.

artist_notes.name: Truncate
artist_notes.note: David Flores — LA producer and co-founder of OBSERVE (with Moe Espinosa/Drumcell); raw, hypnotic, groove-driven techno that's played Berghain, fabric, Concrete and Awakenings. This is his own party's anniversary, not a guest slot.

artist_notes.name: OKTAFORM
artist_notes.note: Recurring visual artist for OBSERVE's parties (also did visuals for their 2024 Speedy J/Drumcell edition) — no separate DJ/production profile found.

1973e2ff27d8.curator_note: OBSERVE has quietly been one of LA's most credible techno institutions for 24 years now — Truncate co-founded it, and getting Chris Liebing to play a 5-hour set for the anniversary instead of a standard hour is exactly the kind of immersive booking worth planning a warehouse night around.
1973e2ff27d8.description: 24th-anniversary edition of OBSERVE, the long-running LA techno party co-founded by Truncate, at a TBA DTLA location — a 5-hour Chris Liebing headline set with Truncate and OKTAFORM visuals, 11pm start.

7fd331b6103e.description: Trap and dubstep pop-up rave (Hex Cougar, Villa, Luciden) at Chubby Cattle BBQ, Rowland Heights, 10pm–2am, $28+.

4ebf165c7763.description: House and tech house night at Los Globos, Silver Lake, 10pm, 21+.

artist_notes.name: Emanate
artist_notes.note: SF-based house/techno duo (Emily Fox & Nathan Vain) who run their own label, Mioli Music, built around rooftop series and open-to-close sets that move through deep house, tech-house and techno.

f700f98ba924.curator_note: This is a label showcase more than a headline booking — Emanate's running their own Mioli Music imprint and playing the whole night themselves, which means a real arc if you trust the selection, but it's not a name that pulls a crowd on its own.
f700f98ba924.description: SF duo Emanate (Mioli Music) plays a solo open-to-close techno/tech-house/deep-house set at a TBA LA location, 10pm-2am.

artist_notes.name: Dossey
artist_notes.note: Austin-based "glitter grunge" pop/indie-pop artist — melodic, hooky songwriting (Animal EP), a real touring act rather than an unknown local opener.

artist_notes.name: Jesse Detor
artist_notes.note: Boston indie-pop songwriter with a real Spotify following (~45K monthly listeners) — 90s-rock-tinged, confessional pop in the Veruca Salt/Phoebe Bridgers vein.

artist_notes.name: Carmela

artist_notes.note: UK garage producer/DJ who founded Kiwi Rekords and has been central to the 2-step/UKG revival — a real fabric/Boiler Room/Printworks name, not a niche curiosity.

797411335624.curator_note: Conducta basically willed the UK garage revival into being with Kiwi Rekords — an all-night solo set is a chance to hear a proper 2-step set stretched out instead of a 45-minute festival slot.

artist_notes.name: Petit Biscuit
artist_notes.note: French producer Mehdi Benjelloun — broke out with the 2015 downtempo hit 'Sunset Lover'; lush, melodic electronica closer to ODESZA/Bonobo territory than house or techno, with genuine festival-headliner credits (Coachella, Lollapalooza).

artist_notes.name: Forester
artist_notes.note: Indie-electronic producer and frequent Petit Biscuit collaborator (their joint single 'Close Your Eyes') — same atmospheric, melodic-minimalist lane.

53cd67ee1b97.curator_note: Petit Biscuit's lush, downtempo-leaning electronica isn't the tech-house lane — think ODESZA/Bonobo mood over dancefloor drive — but he's a legitimate touring name with real festival pedigree, not a bottle-service filler booking at Avalon.

artist_notes.name: Golden Grease
artist_notes.note: LA post-punk/garage/krautrock unit whose debut LP 'Zero Time' came out on Permanent Records itself — rips through hardcore and krautrock influences in barely 22 minutes.

f06cad196fc5.curator_note: This is Permanent Records' actual 20th-birthday show, not a routine bar bill — Zig Zags carry real Stooges/Iggy Pop lineage and Golden Grease's debut is literally on the store's own label, a genuine scene milestone for ten bucks.

artist_notes.name: Dave Aju
artist_notes.note: SF producer (Marc Barrite) and longtime Circus Company artist — soulful, left-field minimal house built from his own vocals and samples; played Fabric, Panorama Bar and Rex Club. A genuinely deep booking for a Halloween party.

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden
artist_notes.note: LA-via-London selector out of the '90s UK queer rave scene — house/techno/disco marathon sets and a longtime DJ Harvey tour collaborator/muse.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

artist_notes.name: Tavish
artist_notes.note: Venice-native LA warehouse-scene DJ (also a Grammy-winning producer as half of Sid Roams) — industrial disco and acid house; a fixture across the city's underground circuit alongside names like Psychemagik and DJ Garth.

artist_notes.name: Things You Say
artist_notes.note: LA club-scene DJ project posting house mixes and playing local nights — low profile, nothing more substantial to verify beyond that.

740d4a684b1c.curator_note: Yamashiro's hillside gardens plus a genuinely deep bill — Dave Aju's Circus Company pedigree next to Heidi Lawden and Masha Mar's disco digging — makes this a rare Halloween party actually worth dressing up for.
740d4a684b1c.description: Halloween costume party in Yamashiro's hillside gardens with house/disco DJs Dave Aju, Heidi Lawden, Masha Mar, Tavish and Things You Say.

artist_notes.name: Bloody Mary
artist_notes.note: French-born, Berlin-based vinyl DJ and producer (real name Marjorie Migliaccio) — hardware-driven house, techno and acid, owns the Dame-Music label; festival credits include Movement Detroit, Sonar and ADE. Genuine European club pedigree.

artist_notes.name: Julia Govor
artist_notes.note: NY-based (Russian-born) techno producer/DJ known for hypnotic, meditative techno — JUJUKA label owner, Lot Radio resident, championed by fabric London.

artist_notes.name: Laure Croft
artist_notes.note: Dutch-born, Berlin-based DJ who plays strictly vinyl, all-techno sets pulled from the mid-90s to mid-2000s — founder of Sexyrecs, a regular at About Blank, Gegen and RSO. A real all-vinyl European booking, not a marketing label.

artist_notes.name: Xica Soul
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

a9e3c3144010.curator_note: An all-vinyl Halloween warehouse booking stacked with legitimate European names — Bloody Mary's acid-techno background and Laure Croft's strictly-vinyl 90s/00s sets next to Julia Govor's hypnotic techno make this the more substantial rave in this week's TBA-warehouse crop.
a9e3c3144010.description: All-vinyl Halloween warehouse rave (TBA LA location) from Incognito and Waxxx Society, with Bloody Mary, Julia Govor, Laure Croft and Xica Soul, 9pm.

artist_notes.name: Ben UFO
artist_notes.note: London selector and Hessle Audio co-founder — one of the most respected, genre-agnostic DJs of his generation, moving between house, techno, bass and garage without ever landing on one lane; a Rinse FM mainstay and reliable Boiler Room legend. About as close to a proper fabric/London booking as LA gets.

artist_notes.name: Bianca Lexis
artist_notes.note: LA dublab/NTS host (Panorama Heaven) and Rhonda regular — genre-bending sets running '80s synth-pop and new wave into boogie, house and italo.

d0cab332db78.curator_note: Ben UFO doesn't play a lane so much as ignore the concept of one — this is a real London import at a TBA warehouse, which is exactly the Lights Down Low afterhours energy that's usually worth building a night around.
d0cab332db78.description: Lights Down Low brings London's Ben UFO to a TBA Downtown LA location with support from Bianca Lexis, doors 11pm.

artist_notes.note: Couldn't verify a substantive bio beyond scattered LA/Inland Empire rave-circuit listings — treat as a local, unproven name.

3c6c7675dfdf.curator_note: Genre tags promising 'hard groove' and 'kawaii bass' in the same breath is a tell this is scrappy DIY disco-rave, not a real booking — fine if you're already at High Tide before 11 for the free RSVP, not worth planning around.

artist_notes.name: Cody Currie
artist_notes.note: London-born, Berlin-based multi-instrumentalist producer at the front of the jazz-house revival — Toy Tonics debut album praised by BBC 6 Music and Mixmag, plus releases on Classic and Shall Not Fade.

artist_notes.name: Barbara Boeing
artist_notes.note: Curitiba-raised, Milan-based Brazilian selector and Toy Tonics artist ('Brasiliana EP') — 15+ years digging, playing disco/house sets rooted in Brazilian rhythm and global crate-digging.

artist_notes.name: Xica Soul
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

a17de0c32473.curator_note: Toy Tonics' touring jam brings genuine label talent to town — Cody Currie's jazz-funk-house and Bárbara Boeing's Brazilian disco digging next to LA's own Xica Soul — a groove-forward bill even though the room is still TBA.
a17de0c32473.description: Toy Tonics' touring party series in DTLA (venue TBA) with label artists Cody Currie and Bárbara Boeing plus LA's Xica Soul, 9pm-3:30am.

artist_notes.name: Roman Flügel
artist_notes.note: Veteran German house/techno producer (Ongaku Musik; "Ganz", "Roman IV") and half of 90s duo Alter Ego — a Live at Robert Johnson/Playhouse-lineage DJ, genuine European club royalty and exactly the fabric/Robert Johnson pedigree this lane is built for.

artist_notes.name: Josh Caffé
artist_notes.note: London DJ/producer/vocalist, fabric's Love Child resident and frontman of house-techno duo Paranoid London — released his debut album 'Poppa Zesque' on Erol Alkan's Phantasy label. A real European club booking with a queer-club, vocal-forward edge.

artist_notes.name: Jane Margarette
artist_notes.note: LA DJ playing house/techno around town with residencies at spots like Better Tomorrow and Psstudio — local support, nothing more substantial to verify.

00ffffa31eda.curator_note: Roman Flügel is legitimate Robert Johnson-lineage house/techno, and Josh Caffé's fabric pedigree (Paranoid London, Love Child) makes this one of the better-booked In Between nights on the calendar, not just another DTLA warehouse listing.
00ffffa31eda.description: In Between hosts German house/techno veteran Roman Flügel and London's Josh Caffé, with support from Jane Margarette, at a TBA DTLA venue, 9pm-4am.

artist_notes.name: Man Power
artist_notes.note: UK DJ/producer (Geoff Kirkwood, Newcastle) and boss of the Me Me Me label — genuinely eclectic cosmic disco, dub techno and throwback piano house; a characterful, Balearic-leaning booking rather than a generic tech-house name.

artist_notes.name: SONNS
artist_notes.note: LA underground fixture (Alexandre Mouracade), founder of Making Shapes and the In Between and DISCOS XXX party series, releases on his own Machine Limited label plus Kompakt and ESP Institute — a punk-rooted, synth-into-house selector who's a real name in this scene.

artist_notes.name: Tavish
artist_notes.note: Venice-native LA warehouse-scene DJ (also a Grammy-winning producer as half of Sid Roams) — industrial disco and acid house; a fixture across the city's underground circuit.

artist_notes.name: Capes
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer/promoter, one half of Club Tularosa — a regular supporting name on the local underground/DIY circuit.

076889a65e41.curator_note: Man Power's unpredictable cosmic-disco sets paired with SONNS' actual LA pedigree (Making Shapes, Kompakt releases) make this the most substantial all-night booking of the DTLA afters crop this week.
076889a65e41.description: Sirens x Dx3 afters (TBA DTLA, 10pm-5am) with UK's Man Power, LA's SONNS and Tavish, Capes and D'ETE.

artist_notes.name: Eli Escobar
artist_notes.note: New York house and disco veteran — 20+ years in the scene, Tiki Disco crew founding member, Night People NYC label boss; sets traverse soulful disco, jazzy house, funk, reggaeton and Afrobeat without losing the floor.

artist_notes.name: DJ Godfather
artist_notes.note: Brian Jeffries — Detroit ghettotech founding father, co-founded Twilight 76 and Databass Records in the mid-'90s fusing Detroit techno with Miami bass. This is bass/electro turf, not the house-techno core lane, but he's the real deal in it.

artist_notes.name: BAE BAE
artist_notes.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, sound artist, Planet Mu signee, and co-founder of Hood Rave (DTLA's queer-Black underground party). Sets weave footwork, juke, breaks and R&B through an explicitly Black-diasporic and femme lens; NTS and Dublab radio host.

artist_notes.name: SYMØNNE
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/producer and founder of Blaque María, an all-woman/queer/BIPOC-centered collective and event brand; started in Boston/Bay Area underground circuits (Burning Man mainstage support) before relocating to LA. Sound leans Chicago house, tech-house, minimal and melodic techno — closer to the taste lane than her ghettotech billmates here.

a3815d6af73b.curator_note: This is a detour from the usual rooftop-house lane — Godfather is Detroit ghettotech royalty, all bass and 909 electro, not deep/disco. Worth it if you want a real TBA-warehouse afterhours with actual genre history behind the headliner rather than a generic late-night DJ booking.

artist_notes.name: Angel Cannon
artist_notes.note: Vancouver-based hard-techno/hardstyle producer-vocalist ('The Green Machine') — releases on Scantraxx and Barong Family, has played EDC Las Vegas; real cred within that scene.

025912dcdf9e.curator_note: Angel Cannon's legit within hard techno/hardstyle circles — EDC Vegas credits, Scantraxx and Barong Family releases — but hard dance is the one lane this taste steers away from outright, so this is a pass unless that's specifically the night you're after.
025912dcdf9e.description: Late-night hard-techno/hardstyle warehouse party headlined by Angel Cannon, with Rio Sky, Ariana Sanjuan, Assidious and Akane, 11:45pm–5am.

artist_notes.name: Onur Özer
artist_notes.note: Istanbul-born, Ibiza/Cocoon-circuit techno DJ — releases on Cocoon Recordings and Vakant since the mid-2000s, longtime Amnesia/DC10 name; deep, hypnotic, properly European in feel.

artist_notes.name: Mayell
artist_notes.note: Slovenian house/deep-house DJ (Luckison crew) who's shared stages with Onur Özer, Craig Richards and Zip — the kind of booking that signals a curated, not generic, lineup.

artist_notes.name: Mesmé
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer (debut EP on Mall Grab's Steel City Dance Discs) — vinyl-heavy blends of moody acid, electro, house and trip-hop; Into the Woods and Dublab resident, Boiler Room 2021.

06f9c7c1261e.curator_note: Onur Özer's Cocoon/Ibiza pedigree plus Mayell (who's literally shared stages with him) makes this Halloween booking sharper than the usual TBA-warehouse techno night — add Mesmé's vinyl-digger set and it's a genuinely stacked bill if the location comes together.
06f9c7c1261e.description: Halloween club night with Cocoon-circuit techno DJ Onur Özer, Slovenian house selector Mayell, LA's Mesmé, Pete Jonas, Rocky and Jackson Algeo at a TBA LA location, 11pm–6am.

19711440faf0.curator_note: No DJs are billed yet — this reads as a costume-and-vibes 70s disco throwdown at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang rather than a bookings-driven night, so it's a maybe until actual names post.
19711440faf0.description: Halloween-themed all-70s disco costume party at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang, Koreatown.

artist_notes.name: Luciid
artist_notes.note: Irish producer (Luke Pollock) and founder of the AGONY imprint — a genuine Beatport-charting schranz/hard-techno name; sets typically build from groove into 145-150bpm techno before tipping into schranz.

artist_notes.name: Callush
artist_notes.note: Berlin-based producer (Carolina Z.) running her own label Riot Tapes — dark industrial techno shot through with EBM and trance, a real fixture on the European hard-techno circuit (DGTL, Mixmag Germany features).

33e5af58ccce.curator_note: Hard techno/schranz isn't the core lane, but Luciid and Callush are both legit names in that world — this is the booking for the rare night you want the harder, faster end of European techno instead of groove.
33e5af58ccce.description: Afterhours hard-techno/schranz night at Exchange LA with touring acts Luciid and Callush, 10pm-3am.

artist_notes.name: Tommy Oeffling
artist_notes.note: Milwaukee-bred indie/slacker-rock songwriter getting real press buzz right now — touring the West Coast with his full band, the B-Team.

3a560ec810dd.curator_note: A touring indie-rock road stop rather than a hometown scene night, but Tommy Oeffling has genuine momentum behind him at the moment — a solid bet for the Roadhouse's small room.
3a560ec810dd.description: Touring indie/slacker-rock songwriter Tommy Oeffling and his band, the B-Team, with support from Augie Isaac, at Permanent Records Roadhouse.

3b3d09d840b8.curator_note: Same low-key no-cover Dresden hang as always — decent filler for a quiet weeknight, not something to build plans around.
3b3d09d840b8.description: No-cover weekly soul/jazz jam session at The Dresden led by vocalist-multi-instrumentalist Luke Strand, with rotating guest musicians.

artist_notes.name: Sam Divine
artist_notes.note: British DJ/producer known as the 'Queen of Defected' — signed to Defected Records in 2009, has hosted their weekly radio show and anchored their Ibiza residencies for over a decade; polished, vocal-driven house.

artist_notes.name: Juliet Mendoza
artist_notes.note: LA-native house DJ and dancer — founder/resident of Jill's House (Jackin Jills), a Defected 'Unsung Heroes' alum; melodic, soulful, deep house rooted in the city's Black/Latin house dance lineage.

5c5d0f8a953f.curator_note: Sam Divine is about as real as the Defected lane gets — a decade-plus atop their radio show and Ibiza bookings — and pairing her with Juliet Mendoza (also a Defected alum) makes this the most legitimately on-pedigree house night in this batch.
5c5d0f8a953f.description: Mixmag Lab LA brings Defected Records mainstay Sam Divine to 1720 alongside LA house DJ Juliet Mendoza.

artist_notes.name: DJ Masda
artist_notes.note: Japan-born, Berlin-based co-founder of CABARET Recordings — vinyl digger since the '90s pulling from early techno, futurist electro and playful house; RA Podcast/Dimensions pedigree, has played LA's Pattern Bar before.

artist_notes.name: Mesmé
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer (debut EP on Mall Grab's Steel City Dance Discs) — vinyl-heavy blends of moody acid, electro, house and trip-hop; Into the Woods and Dublab resident, Boiler Room 2021.

artist_notes.name: Etari
artist_notes.note: LA-based (Orange County-raised) producer and AUNTIE co-founder — house through trance and techno, with releases on 100% Silk; regular on the Lights Down Low/HARD Summer circuit.

artist_notes.name: Chemtrail Johnny
artist_notes.note: SoCal DJ/producer working in minimal, laid-back house and techno grooves — low profile but a real local scene name.

artist_notes.name: Connor Mikami
artist_notes.note: Founder of If You Know You Know, the LA party/label series this event IS — longtime local selector working vintage breaks, electro and club records.

64bea7059714.curator_note: Connor Mikami's own IYKYK series flying in DJ Masda's Tokyo-to-Berlin crate-digging, but the bench underneath is the real reason to go — Mesmé and Etari both have real footprints of their own (Boiler Room, HARD Summer). TBA plus a 10pm-7am billing means an actual underground room, not a bar with a DJ booth.
64bea7059714.description: TBA-location LA afterhours party from Connor Mikami's IYKYK series, headlined by Berlin-based DJ Masda (CABARET Recordings) with Mesmé, Etari and Chemtrail Johnny in support, 10pm-7am.

artist_notes.name: Pilo
artist_notes.note: LA producer/sound designer (Cameron Ward) — released on Turbo Recordings, has collaborated with Boys Noize; teaches this techno-production intensive at IO Music Academy.

792e8d8e4915.curator_note: Worth flagging this is a hands-on production class, not a night out — Pilo's got real credentials (Turbo, a Boys Noize collab) if you actually want to learn to make techno, but it doesn't belong next to the club picks.
792e8d8e4915.description: Hands-on techno-production workshop at IO Music Academy taught by LA producer Pilo (Cameron Ward, Turbo Recordings).

artist_notes.name: Seven Lions
artist_notes.note: Jeff Montalvo — melodic dubstep/bass pioneer and Ophelia Records founder; the genre-defining name pulling this bill outside the house/techno lane.

artist_notes.name: TOKiMONSTA
artist_notes.note: LA producer (Jennifer Lee) — Grammy-nominated future-beat/bass artist and one of the first women to headline a Coachella mainstage set; genre-blending rather than straight house/techno.

artist_notes.name: Tchami
artist_notes.note: French DJ/producer who coined 'future house' and runs the Confession label/party brand — the more house-leaning name on an otherwise bass-heavy bill.

artist_notes.name: Oliver Heldens
artist_notes.note: Dutch producer — broke out with 2014's 'Gecko,' a future-house pioneer alongside Tchami; also runs a deeper techno alias, HI-LO.

artist_notes.name: Gordo
artist_notes.note: Formerly Carnage — the trap/EDM producer rebranded into house a few years back and now runs with the Solid Grooves crowd; a genuine lane-shift, not just a rename.

artist_notes.name: Flosstradamus
artist_notes.note: Chicago duo (Curt Cameruci, Josh Young) — one of the acts that built festival trap in the early 2010s, still a heavy bass-stage draw.

artist_notes.name: Mija
artist_notes.note: LA bass/house DJ-producer in the Brownies & Lemonade orbit — eclectic, genre-hopping sets that land more bass-forward than house.

artist_notes.name: R3hab
artist_notes.note: Dutch big-room/progressive house DJ-producer (Cyb3rpvnk) — festival-mainstage staple for over a decade.

artist_notes.name: Archie Hamilton
artist_notes.note: London DJ/producer/label owner — an early architect of a rugged, atmospheric minimal-house-and-techno sound; MicroHertz label boss and a Paradise Ibiza regular.

artist_notes.name: James Hype
artist_notes.note: UK tech-house/bass-house DJ-producer — viral 'Ferrari' remix and a PIRATE Copenhagen resident; crossed from underground tech-house into a full mainstage festival draw.

artist_notes.name: Ranger Trucco
artist_notes.note: Michigan-born tech-house producer/vocalist, Space Yacht signee — clean, warbling tech-house with his own sung hooks.

artist_notes.name: TOBEHONEST
artist_notes.note: LA-based tech-house DJ/producer on the come-up — Latin-groove/hip-hop-inflected sound with Beatport Top 100 releases and cosigns from Chris Lake and John Summit.

artist_notes.name: TroyBoi
artist_notes.note: UK bass/trap producer known for a distinctive chopped-vocal sound — a big mainstage draw in the bass-music world, outside the house/techno lane.

artist_notes.name: Walker & Royce
artist_notes.note: LA house/tech-house duo — Dirtybird-adjacent, quirky vocal-driven house cuts; a home-turf name on this bill.

535f6e34e59c.curator_note: Insomniac's flagship NYE blowout at NOS — DJ Snake, Alesso and Marshmello are real headliners, and there's a genuine house/tech-house thread running through Gordo, Walker & Royce and TOBEHONEST, but most of this 30-deep bill is bass/trap/dubstep mainstage stuff, not a selector's set. Go for the production and the countdown, not the DJing.
535f6e34e59c.description: Insomniac's Countdown NYE 2026 at NOS Event Center — a 30-plus-artist multi-stage lineup headlined by DJ Snake, Alesso and Marshmello, running house through bass/trap into midnight.

artist_notes.name: NEOFX
artist_notes.note: Paris/Berlin-based hard-techno, acid and neorave producer — fast, hard-hitting 150-165bpm tracks, 5M+ plays and 50K+ monthly listeners. A different, faster lane than the house/techno spine.

53dbb6d89c28.curator_note: NEOFX is a legit European hard-techno/acid/neorave name with real streaming numbers, but that's a harder, faster lane than the usual groove — free warehouse party is the right price to sample it, not something to plan a whole night around.
53dbb6d89c28.description: Free warehouse party from Inland Empire crew Inland Groove and Los Perros, headlined by Paris/Berlin hard-techno and acid producer NEOFX.

artist_notes.name: Rodriguez Jr.
artist_notes.note: French producer Olivier Mateu (mentored by Laurent Garnier, came up via F-Communications) — 20+ years into a warm, cinematic strain of melodic house/techno, records on Mobilee, Anjunadeep and Systematic.

artist_notes.name: Kenny Dope
artist_notes.note: One half of the legendary Masters at Work (with Louie Vega) — 30+ years deep into foundational NYC house; the single most significant name on this bill.

artist_notes.name: Floorplan
artist_notes.note: Robert Hood & daughter Lyric Hood — Detroit techno royalty (M-Plant) turned deep, gospel-inflected house. 'Baby Baby' fills a floor for a reason.

artist_notes.name: HoneyLuv
artist_notes.note: Cleveland-born, ex-Navy — one of the biggest tech-house breakouts of the last few years; soulful, groovy end of the genre, runs her own 4 Tha Luv label.

artist_notes.name: Kitty Amor
artist_notes.note: London-based Afro house DJ, Get Physical/Mahaba Music — founded Motherland, an Afro house platform/collective; regular at Hi Ibiza and Grow London.

artist_notes.name: canary yellow
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/producer (Denver-raised), a fixture of the local club scene — house and club-edit tracks out on Traxsource.

artist_notes.name: Faster Horses
artist_notes.note: UK (Manchester) DJ Joe Germains, describes his sound as trance/techno/psychedelia — plays for the Teletech and Interplanetary Criminal party circuits; releases on Euromantic and RAW.

artist_notes.name: Azyr / Shankz / STARRZA / TDJ / Natte Visstick / Desa Deca / EMILIJA
artist_notes.note: The extended Teletech crew Faster Horses reps (the Manchester-born hard/fast-techno collective now touring globally) filling out the bill — couldn't verify individual bios beyond that co-billing, so treat this stretch as a wildcard.

artist_notes.name: Coco & Breezy
artist_notes.note: Twin sisters (also the eyewear-brand founders) turned house/dance DJ duo — danceable, R&B-tinged, more crossover-pop energy than underground.

artist_notes.name: Hannah Laing
artist_notes.note: Dundee DJ, ex-dental technician turned fast-rising UK name — high-energy trance and hard house, runs the doof label and just launched her own festival.

artist_notes.name: STRAWBRY
artist_notes.note: LA underground fixture (South Florida-raised) — breaks-and-house sets, runs the STUDIO5400 party series.

artist_notes.name: Vieze Asbak
artist_notes.note: Dutch 'memecore'/troll-rave artist out of Amsterdam's Pestcore Collectief — hard-dance-adjacent chaos, not clean house or techno. A sign this bill gets weird in spots.

artist_notes.name: Jazzy (IRL)
artist_notes.note: Couldn't pin down a confident bio for this one — flagging as unverified rather than guessing.

62a0171faab5.curator_note: This has grown into one of the more scattershot bills on the radar since it was first booked — Kenny Dope's actual Masters at Work pedigree, Robert Hood's gospel-house Floorplan, HoneyLuv's tech-house heat, Skepta stepping behind the decks, Kitty Amor's Afro house, LA's own canary yellow, and a chunk of Manchester's hard/fast Teletech crew all sharing stages at El Pueblo — expect real swings in sound depending which stage you're standing at, not one coherent vibe.
62a0171faab5.description: Multi-stage Boiler Room Sunday day party at El Pueblo Historic Monument spanning Kenny Dope, Floorplan, HoneyLuv, Skepta's DJ set, Kitty Amor's Afro house, canary yellow and Manchester's Teletech crew.

3a4144e4a14b.curator_note: No billed DJs to vouch for here — Gold Diggers' bar sets can be genuinely good, but 'House and Hits' branding reads more crowd-pleaser than digger, so call this a maybe-swing-by rather than a plan-around.
3a4144e4a14b.description: Weekly-style house and dance-hits night at the Gold Diggers bar in East Hollywood, no DJs listed.

7074846ce0e3.description: Free late-night hard techno party in a secret Downtown LA location (11:45pm).

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden
artist_notes.note: LA-via-London selector out of the '90s UK queer rave scene — house/techno/disco marathon sets and a longtime DJ Harvey tour collaborator/muse. (cached)

artist_notes.name: Star Amerasu
artist_notes.note: LA-based musician/DJ/performance artist (formerly Ah-Mer-Ah-Su) — a genuine name in queer club culture, profiled by Billboard, Paper and Interview; house/tech-house sets alongside her own released records. Real draw within that scene.

artist_notes.name: Things You Say
artist_notes.note: LA club-scene DJ project posting house mixes and playing local nights — low profile, nothing more substantial to verify beyond that. (cached)

artist_notes.name: KNOXDOTMP3
artist_notes.note: Dominican-Cuban DJ, NYC-raised and LA-based since 2020 — genre-fluid house/disco/Jersey club/ballroom edits; plays LA staples like Rhonda and Ostbahnhof.

artist_notes.name: Rob Aquino
artist_notes.note: LA promoter/DJ who throws Loose (with Banoffee) — one of the city's flagship gay parties; well-connected fixture of the queer nightlife scene, not primarily known as a touring selector.

e3de11d378fc.curator_note: Carty Supreme's Whatever parties are LA's ballroom-adjacent queer nightlife at its best — Star Amerasu's a legitimate name in that world and Heidi Lawden basically apprenticed under DJ Harvey — but this is a queer day-to-night party through and through, not a club-night booking in your usual lane.
e3de11d378fc.description: TBA-location day-to-night house party from promoter Carty Supreme with Star Amerasu, Heidi Lawden, KNOXDOTMP3, Rob Aquino and Things You Say.

artist_notes.name: Kozlov
artist_notes.note: French producer (Florian Kozlowski) working hard techno/schranz/industrial — tracks like 'Tchernobyl' have real circulation in that circuit. A genuine touring name in the hard-techno lane, not a local fill-in.

79d6d412c597.curator_note: Kozlov's a legit force in hard techno/schranz right now, but a 4:30am warehouse night built on that much distortion is pure adrenaline over selection — the kind of EDM-adjacent rave your taste explicitly steers around, headliner credibility aside.

dj nuts.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

cut chemist.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

waajeed.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

shdw.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

bradley zero.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

masha mar.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

neeko.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

krane.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

ayybo.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

ragie ban.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

dj minx.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

josh caffé.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

farralone.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

trovarsi.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

e m bae.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

92jelani.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

hot since 82.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

claude vonstroke.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

ardalan.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

todd edwards.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

cut snake.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

falcons.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

ak chamel the giver of illness.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

derek monypeny.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

xica soul.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

cassian.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

kamino.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

eddie c.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.
